#!/usr/bin/python
"""Convert the documented fixed-width warehouse records to CSV."""
from __future__ import print_function

import csv
import io
import os
import sys

RECORD_WIDTH = 21


def reject(rejects, line_number, reason, record):
    rejects.write("%d: %s: %s\n" % (line_number, reason, record))


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: %s INPUT\n" % sys.argv[0])
        return 2

    input_path = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
    reject_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(input_path), "rejects.txt")

    writer = csv.writer(sys.stdout, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("id", "name", "quantity"))

    with io.open(input_path, "r", encoding="ascii", newline="") as source, \
            io.open(reject_path, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="") as rejects:
        for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(source, 1):
            record = raw_line[:-1] if raw_line.endswith("\n") else raw_line

            if len(record) != RECORD_WIDTH:
                reject(rejects, line_number,
                       "wrong length %d (expected %d)" %
                       (len(record), RECORD_WIDTH), record)
                continue

            record_id = record[0:5]
            name = record[5:17].rstrip(" ")
            quantity = record[17:21]
            if not quantity or any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in quantity):
                reject(rejects, line_number, "nonnumeric quantity", record)
                continue

            writer.writerow((record_id, name, quantity))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
